approvedRows.currentState: Repo-local dogfooding is supervised, but it can hide fresh-project package, bootstrap, and host-runner lifecycle drift.
approvedRows.desiredState: CodeWiki has an external package dogfood smoke that runs a guarded lifecycle in a fresh project before broader self-hosting.
approvedRows.rationale: External package validation is the next safe gate before trusting broader CodeWiki dogfooding.
approvedRows.userImpact: Improves user outcomes by preserving clear project intent.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Keeps implementation cost bounded and reviewable.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.

agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Improves CodeWiki while preserving trace-backed source truth.
agentAssessment.rationale: No lower-cost alternative better serves the user and project.

approvedRows.safetyBoundary: Package-installed CodeWiki may mutate only an isolated external project using expected-byte and sequence guards.
failureModes: Repo-local parent discovery hides missing bootstrap behavior.
Packed package cannot drive /wiki bootstrap or tool lifecycle mutation.
Runtime host worker output collection fails after package installation.
Release or archive close fails in a fresh project.
approvedRows.negativeTestPlan: Assert /wiki state fails before bootstrap, then require guarded append throughout the external lifecycle smoke.
approvedRows.compatibilityImpact: Validation is added without broadening public API or unattended automation authority.
approvedRows.currentPain: The current behavior leaves project intent less structured than it could be.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: The decision creates a clearer, more useful project outcome.
approvedRows.successSignal: Planning can consume the decision without additional intent clarification.
nonGoals: Do not expand scope beyond the approved decision row.
